subject: art-design

moments.title: Just what is it that makes today's homes...?
moments.body: Hamilton's collage for the 'This Is Tomorrow' exhibition prefigures Pop's love of advertising and consumer imagery.

moments.title: Campbell's Soup Cans
moments.body: Warhol exhibits 32 canvases, one for each soup variety. The Ferus Gallery sells most for around $100 each.

moments.title: Whaam!
moments.body: Lichtenstein paints a fighter plane attack in Ben-Day dots, magnifying comic-book style.
moments.takeaway: Pop turned popular print into high art.

now.title: Pop today
now.body: Warhol's Marilyn diptych and other works regularly set auction records. Brand image debates persist around Hockney, Koons and KAWS.
now.open_questions: What is the line between Pop and product?

reflection: Pop made the question 'is this art?' part of the work itself.
